item.title: Kristofer Hallén
item.description:
I am a principal developer at Ericsson and mostly work with continous integration (CI) and deployment (CD) and development environments. I have worked with software development as a developer, architect and product owner in telecom and automotive. I like to read and you find my Sherlock Holmes library here. Talk to me on Bluesky
